## What you will build

Combine collections, decisions, loops, functions, and copying to allocate limited supplies.

Follow the units in order and complete each unit challenge. Keep examples and
debugging notes that help explain your choices. This overview is orientation,
not a scored activity.
<!-- fcpython-chapter-lab: end -->

## Unit sequence

1. [Organizing and Traversing Collections](units/collections-iteration/index.qmd) — 7 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/collections-iteration/challenge.qmd).
2. [Making Decisions and Repeating Work](units/decisions-repetition/index.qmd) — 8 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/decisions-repetition/challenge.qmd).
3. [Building Reusable Functions](units/functions-call-behavior/index.qmd) — 8 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/functions-call-behavior/challenge.qmd).
4. [Sharing, Changing, and Copying Objects](units/mutability-identity-copying/index.qmd) — 4 lessons and a [unit challenge](units/mutability-identity-copying/challenge.qmd).

## Prepare and pace your work

Complete the preceding milestone in the [course sequence](../../index.qmd),
or review its outcomes if you already have that experience. Use each unit's
active-time estimate and pause at lesson boundaries. Plan another 2–4 hours for
the milestone challenge, including rerunning checks and explaining your result.

Use Colab for notebook exercises and the workspace introduced in the units for
local environment, packaging, and command-line tasks.

## Connect the units

Finish with [Route Supplies through a Puzzle Village](challenge.qmd). Combine the milestone skills and check a
changed condition. The challenge provides a contract, expected results, a hint,
and self-review guidance.
